2024 total loan amount compared to 2023 total, percentage growth
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount
  FROM shg_loan_register
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) IN (2023, 2024)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT total_amount FROM yearly_totals WHERE year = 2024) AS total_2024,
  (SELECT total_amount FROM yearly_totals WHERE year = 2023) AS total_2023,
  ((SELECT total_amount FROM yearly_totals WHERE year = 2024) - (SELECT total_amount FROM yearly_totals WHERE year = 2023)) / NULLIF((SELECT total_amount FROM yearly_totals WHERE year = 2023), 0) * 100 AS percentage_growth
```
